entry_state: Restoration and assurance retain different obligations and measurement histories. The mixed amendment combines a construction catch-up with prospective distinct visits, reaching the same lifetime revenue 170 and profit 58. A changed billing schedule now creates receivables and contract balances separately: the first invoice credits advance 30 and leaves receivable 50, then collection 20 leaves 30. The contract-balance calculation continues on page 139.
exit_state: Paid-or-due consideration counts credited advances once, and the billing identity reconciles balances independently of the payment schedule. Unfinished production uses different material and conversion denominators; joint products and byproducts retain their own allocation bases. Supplier financing separates inventory cost from interest. The uncertain-tax case has introduced full-information examination and measurement choice, with its numerical branches continuing next.
findings: The billing derivation explicitly substitutes cash, receivable and net contract balances; cancellation checks arithmetic but does not supply missing contractual findings.
The unfinished-production example preserves material and conversion progress separately and treats equivalent units as a scoped policy, not verbatim IAS 2 requirements.
Joint-product, byproduct and delayed supplier-payment examples preserve separate cost or financing mechanisms and reconcile their stated amounts.
The uncertain-tax introduction rejects discounting exposure by a guessed chance of avoiding examination. Its calculation is not yet complete. No new confirmed defect.
